details:
VRChat has a serious problem with it's simple friends list and online status. We really need a revamp of this system to allow for a few groups or levels of different friends, and the ability to override or set online status based on those groups or levels.

Right now we have no way to differentiate between best/close friends, general friends, and acquaintances. This leads to many people being on orange status most of the time because, while you may have friends you'd be happy seeing anytime or in any mood, you don't want every single person on that list joining openly all the time.

My feature request is as follows...

Short term: Allow us to set a status override for those friends who have been marked as "favorite" friends. So we can override our current status for these friends and tell the system we always want to show up as blue/green/whatever status to them. This would be a good quick fix.

Longer term: Create friend groups for best/close friends, general friends, and acquaintances. New friends are immediately added to the acquaintances group and can then been moved up to the general friends or best/close friends group. Allow a status override for both the general friends and best/close friends groups.

By default there is one status as there is now, but each group can be overridden if the user wishes. This allows simple status setting for most people and advanced status setting for more experienced users.

Thanks for your consideration of this needed feature request.
title: Revamp friends list and allow online status override per group or level.
